# OCI Monitoring

### Known gaps

- Alarm overrides, ruleName rules and evaluationSlackDuration are stored but not evaluated: the SDK says each override is evaluated in order and then BASE (monitoring AlarmOverride and CreateAlarmDetails comments) but defines no per-rule state, history or message shape, and the default slack (PT3M) would delay every evaluation in alarm tests; evaluation is one rule per alarm in eval.go:evaluate.
- MQL lacks grouping(), nested queries and joins (&& and ||): the MQL reference page documents arithmetic (+ - * / %) and the joins but gives no syntax for grouping() or nested queries (mql.go ParseMQL rejects them).
- IAM policy checks, resource principals and instance principals are not applied; only API-key signatures are verified (out of scope: IAM evaluation).
